observations.code_quote: Note: `GET /servers/{deviceID}/packages` was checked and not built. It returns the same `Packages` schema as `GET /orgs/{orgID}/packages`, which the spec describes as covering every device in the organization and whose rows already carry `server_id`, so the synced `packages` table is already the per-device patch inventory. Fanning out per device would rebuild that table at one paginated walk per device.
